# Run: python3 quiz.py
qa = [
    ("What is Compound interest?", "the growth on growth over time"),
    ("What is Budget?", "a plan giving every dollar a job"),
    ("State one governing principle of personal finance basics.", "Kill high-interest debt before investing."),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    print(f"A{i}: {a}")
    score += 1
print(f"Quiz complete: reviewed {score} of {len(qa)} key points.")
demo.note: Runnable Python self-quiz. Run with: python3 quiz.py
